name: Two-Thruster Drone
notion: A linear combination a·u + b·v mixes two vectors. Two vectors on the same line can only reach that line.

tiers.banner: u and v are drawn: the drone only flies when you lock in
NEW RULE · THRUSTERS HIDDEN — only their numbers
NEW RULE · REACHABLE OR NOT? answer first

story.intro: The drone bay lost its mixing rule. Two thrusters, one target: teach it to combine.
story.cleared: Drones fly again. Every reachable point is a mix of u and v.
